title: GateRun
description: MCP gate_status: the async gate run handle for a review_plan_start, verify_completion_start, review_code_start, or transition_ticket_start job (gate_type plan_review, verify_completion, code_review, or transition). `status` is running, then passed or failed; attaching awaits a duplicate's index record, and unknown marks an unrecognized job id (which carries no ticket_id, gate_type, or findings). A settled run adds verdict, error, durable (signed-certificate currency), and findings (plan-review sidecar readability).
